text:
alice: quick heads up 11/14 23:45 UTC75 - running tenant_shard_index_swap tonight in the quiet window. tagging @tom @nina and @sre-oncall. deploy-bot scheduled. saw longer lock hold in rehearsal.

tom: ack. what's the immediate abort criteria?

alice: abort if replica_lag > 20s OR any lock_wait > 10s sustained for 60s. rollback = pin schema to v20251110_09 and disable flag tenants.shard_index_live. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/shard-index-swap (see escape hatch).

nina: I'll flip the short write-freeze at -5m and monitor WAL backlog. API: POST /internal/flags {flag:tenants.shard_index_swap,on:true}.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled 'tenant_shard_index_swap' for 2025-11-14T23:45Z. Canary 3% then phased to 25% -> 100% with autosafety gates.

sre-oncall: Preflight checklist: confirm replica sync <8s, WAL backlog <25s, run sample SELECT to estimate backfill rows. Escape: abort canary, pin schema, restart writers if WAL > 40s.

tom: running sample: `SELECT count(*) FROM tenant_shards WHERE needs_swap = true;` -- ~47k rows.

alice: canary started 2345Z routing 3%. initial metrics: latency +2ms, 5xx 0.1%.

nina: flipped flag at 23:40 :white_check_mark: queued background job shard_index_fill but will pause on lock pressure.

sre-oncall: seeing replica_lag climb 6s -> 11s; warning threshold 10s.

alice: reduce canary to 1% and pause shard_index_fill. set safemode db.lock_timeout=2000ms.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scaled canary to 1% and paused job 'shard_index_fill'.

tom: lag stabilizing ~9s. holding for 8m before next step.

alice: decision: continue 1% for 10m. escalate if lag > 18s or any sustained lock wait > 12s. rollback if user errors >0.4% or spike in 5xx.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary complete at 23:56Z. no abort. preparing wave2 (25%).

nina: adding release note: "tenant shard index swap 11/1475 phased rollout with short write-freeze and backfill pause on contention."

tom: I'll stand by to execute pin SQL if we abort. Thanks team.
